decisionRuleCorrection: The 2026-08-12 rule 3 noindexed any page that was 'Discovered - currently not indexed, or unknown despite being in the sitemap'. Those two coverage states are not equivalent: the first is Google declining to index a page it fetched, the second is Google never having fetched it. Retiring the second converts a discovery problem into a permanent one. Execution therefore applies noindex only to 'Discovered - currently not indexed'.
deferralReason: All 19 MERGE decisions are guide URLs, and the 2026-08-12 clustering ran per-language: the EN and ES clusters picked different winners for the same concept. Propagating each merge to its language counterpart would merge two surviving winners away (/guides/how-to-mix-audio-for-social-video and /guides/drone-video-editing-guidelines-florida) and create redirect chains. Choosing one winner per concept across both languages is an editorial decision, not a mechanical one, so the merges are deferred to a follow-up rather than executed unsafely here. The 40 noindex decisions are independent of pairing and ship now.
pairSymmetryRule: NOINDEX is applied only when both halves of a language pair qualify. 12 URLs were promoted back to KEEP under this rule.
guideScopeRule: This pass touches service and niche pages only. Every /guides/ and /es/guias/ URL is deferred to the merge track.
